summary: Leader's Advantage Acquisition Corp., a Cayman-incorporated, Nasdaq-listed blank-check company, filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, announcing that beginning November 6, 2026 unit holders may elect to separate their IPO units into Class A ordinary shares and one-half warrants. Post-separation, shares trade under LEDR and whole warrants under LEDRW, each exercisable at $11.50 per share; unseparated units continue as LEDRU. No fractional warrants will be issued, and separation requires broker contact with transfer agent Odyssey Transfer Trust Company. This is a routine SPAC unit-separation mechanics event, not a business combination; no target, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock was disclosed. Watch for any eventual de-SPAC announcement, redemption dynamics, and warrant overhang as the arbitrage angle.
